capabilities: push the active note to a Notion database page
pull a linked Notion page back into the active note
map frontmatter keys to Notion properties
fetch the remote database property schema for mapping dropdowns
store the linked Notion page ID as notionPageId in frontmatter
extras: Warns users to keep the integration token private and not to commit it to source control. No bulk 'sync all databases' command; only active-note workflows. UI copy is available in English and Simplified Chinese.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push or pull individual notes and their properties against Notion database pages.

relations.evidence: syncing the active Markdown note with a selected Notion database

summary: Bidirectional sync of the active Markdown note with a Notion database, mapping frontmatter properties and storing the linked page ID.
